note: How to read the export of the Example ICP-2, the simulated in-circuit programmer at the FPGA example's EMS (tools/hslsa/fpgaboard.go). It programs assembled boards rather than loose parts, and talks to the root of trust on each board: it reads the part's serial (ROT_SERIAL) and asks it for its IDevID CSR (ROT_CSR), both at the part's reference designator, and powers the board once at the end (POWER_UP). Its program file, log layout, time format and words all differ from the XG-8's.
